sequence.subject: Introducing Bookings Companion
sequence.preview: An official introduction to ClinicPlus Bookings Companion, an optional tool for existing ClinicPlus clients.
sequence.headline: Introducing ClinicPlus Bookings Companion
sequence.intro: We're introducing ClinicPlus Bookings Companion, an optional booking support tool for existing ClinicPlus clients who manage repeat employee medical bookings.
body: Bookings Companion works with your existing ClinicPlus login. It helps you keep a reusable employee roster, organise people by site, shift, occupation, or group, and prepare bulk medical bookings without retyping the same details each time.

This introduction includes 300 trial credits so you can explore the tool on your own account before deciding whether it is useful for your team. ClinicPlus bookings can still be made directly through the usual ClinicPlus website at any time.
bullets: Use your existing ClinicPlus account details to log in
Import employees from previous ClinicPlus appointments where available
Save roster details once, then reuse them for future bookings
Submit appointments into ClinicPlus through the same booking system your team already uses
sequence.footNote: You are receiving this because this email address is listed as a ClinicPlus client booking contact. Bookings Companion is optional, and every credit-based action shows its cost before you confirm it.

sequence.subject: A closer look at Bookings Companion
sequence.preview: How the optional ClinicPlus Bookings Companion roster and bulk-booking tools work.
sequence.headline: A simpler way to prepare repeat bookings
sequence.intro: If your team often books the same employees for occupational medicals, Bookings Companion is designed to reduce the admin before the appointment is submitted.
body: You can build a roster once, keep employee details in one place, and group employees in a way that matches how your organisation works. When the next booking is due, you select the relevant people, confirm the service and clinic date, and submit the appointment.
The aim is practical: fewer repeated forms, fewer missed ID numbers or job spec files, and a clearer view of what has already been booked.
bullets: Roster: save employee details, occupations, sites, and job spec files
Groups: organise employees by crew, department, shift, site, or occupation
Bulk booking: prepare one appointment for one employee or a full group
Compliance view: see upcoming medical expiries from your roster
Spend insights: review appointment spend by company and service
Multi-company access: switch between linked ClinicPlus companies from one login
sequence.footNote: Nothing runs automatically. You choose what to import, what to save, and what to submit. Your trial credits are available when you log in through this invitation.

sequence.subject: Reminder: your Bookings Companion introduction
sequence.preview: A final reminder about the optional ClinicPlus Bookings Companion introduction.
sequence.headline: Your Bookings Companion invite is still available
sequence.intro: This is a short final reminder about ClinicPlus Bookings Companion, the optional tool introduced to help existing ClinicPlus clients manage repeat employee medical bookings.
body: If you would like to try it, log in with the ClinicPlus account you already use and explore the roster, grouping, compliance, and bulk-booking tools with the trial credits included in this invitation.
Trying Bookings Companion does not change your ClinicPlus account, and you can continue booking directly through ClinicPlus exactly as before.
bullets: No new account is required
Your existing ClinicPlus login is used
Trial credits are included for this introduction
Every credit cost is shown before you confirm an action
sequence.footNote: This is the final email in this introduction sequence. If Bookings Companion is not relevant to you, no action is needed.

sequence.subject: Introducing ClinicPlus Admin Companion
sequence.preview: A professional operations and business-intelligence platform for ClinicPlus administration teams.
sequence.headline: Introducing ClinicPlus Admin Companion
sequence.intro: I’m Ayabonga Qwabi from Qwabi Engineering and Namoota Technologies Pty Ltd. We work closely with ClinicPlus to design and develop the digital platforms supporting its operations, including the recently upgraded ClinicPlus Admin Platform, version 3.1.
body: Earlier this week, we introduced ClinicPlus Booking Companion, a web application that helps ClinicPlus power users create, manage, store, and reuse employee, company, appointment, and booking information more efficiently.
Today, I’m pleased to introduce a new platform built specifically for ClinicPlus administration teams: ClinicPlus Admin Companion.

ClinicPlus Admin Companion is a premium operations and business-intelligence platform that gives administrators a clearer view of their customers, team activity, operational performance, and overall use of the ClinicPlus ecosystem.
The objective is simple: to help ClinicPlus administrators understand what is happening across their operations, identify areas requiring attention, and make better-informed decisions.
As an introductory offer, your first month is free. Thereafter, the Standard plan is available for R299 per user per month.
We built this platform for professional admin teams seeking stronger customer relationships, better operational visibility, and greater control over their day-to-day work.
bullets: Customer relationship management and communication tools
Bulk email campaigns for marketing and transactional communication
Signup, login, and user-engagement intelligence
Usage analytics across users, devices, locations, and activity patterns
Appointment, company, and customer lifecycle insights
Financial and subscription visibility
Data-quality monitoring
Support-ticket management
Controls supporting platform safety and availability
Admin activity analytics for improving workflows and team performance
sequence.loginNote: Your first month is free. Standard access renews at R299 per user per month after the introductory period.
sequence.footer: You are receiving this because this email address is linked to a ClinicPlus administration account or a ClinicPlus-related client contact. ClinicPlus Admin Companion is built by Qwabi Engineering and Namoota Technologies Pty Ltd as a professional admin operations platform for ClinicPlus teams.
sequence.footNote: ClinicPlus Admin Companion is designed for administration teams that need stronger customer relationships, better operational visibility, and greater control over daily work.
